*[[ASUS GT-BE19000AI]] (ROG Rapture) • [[ASUS ROG Rapture GT-BE19000AI]] • BE19000 :Innovative Tri-core architecture: CPU, NPU, MCU. AI Power-Saving mode, RF Scanner, :ROG AI Game Booster, Adaptive QoS 2.0, Ad Blocker, Tracker Blocker, Network Insight
===Specifications=== :• Processor: 2.6GHz quad-core processor :• Memory: 32+16 GB Flash and 4+4 GB RAM :• Product Segment: BE19000: 1376+5762+11525 Mbps :• Transmit/Receive: 2.4GHz 4x4, 5GHz 4x4, 6GHz 4x4 :• Data Rate: ::WiFi 7 (802.11be) (2.4GHz): up to 1376 Mbps ::WiFi 7 (802.11be) (5GHz): up to 5762 Mbps ::WiFi 7 (802.11be) (6GHz): up to 11525 Mbps ::Antenna: External antenna x8 :• Ports: ::1x 10Gbps for WAN/LAN, 1x 10Gbps for LAN ::1x 2.5Gbps for WAN/LAN, 3x 2.5Gbps for LAN ::1x GbE for LAN, 1x USB 3.2 (Gen 1), 1x USB 2.0
==Links of Interest== ===Models=== *[[ASUS RT-BE96U]] • BE19000 Tri Band WiFi Router • Wi-Fi 7 (BE19000) • [https://www.asus.com/Networking-IoT-Servers/WiFi-Routers/ASUS-Gaming-Routers/RT-BE96U/ PPage] :Tri-band Wi-Fi 7 Router, 802.11be: 2.4GHz 4x4 + 5GHz 4x4 + 6GHz 4x4, 2x 10G :Gaming features: Mobile game mode, ASUS features: AiMesh, AiProtection :FCC ID: MSQ-RTBE6G00 (2023-10-03) *[[ASUS ROG Rapture GT-BE98]] • [[ASUS GT-BE98]] • Wi-Fi 7 (BE25000) • [https://rog.asus.com/networking/rog-rapture-gt-be98-model/ PPage] • [https://www.tomshardware.com/news/asus-wifi-7-gaming-routers PR] :Quad-band Wi-Fi 7 Gaming Router, 320MHz BW, 4096-QAM, 2x 10G, 4x 2.5G, 1x 1GbE :Multi-link operation (MLO), Puncturing, VPN Fusion, Triple-level game acceleration, :Mobile game mode, Quad Level Security, AiMesh, RangeBoost Plus, AURA RGB *[[ASUS ROG Rapture GT-BE98 Pro]] • [[ASUS GT-BE98 Pro]] • Wi-Fi 7 (BE30000) • [https://rog.asus.com/networking/rog-rapture-gt-be98-pro/ PPage] :Quad-band Wi-Fi 7 Gaming Router, 320MHz BW, 4096-QAM, 2x 10G, 4x 2.5G, 1x 1GbE :Backup WAN, Triple-level Game Acceleration, Mobile Game Mode, AURA RGB, AiMesh :FCC ID: MSQ-RTBE6M00 (2023-10-04)
